LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Sp.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.drainRecursive_top_prefix_of_bounded_contract
LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Sp.type:
∀ (bound fuel : ℕ) (heap : Array ℕ),
  (∀ (candidate : Array ℕ),
      LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap candidate →
        candidate.size ≤ bound →
          LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.PopMaxRestCorrectFor LeanExperiments.HeapSort.popMaxRecursive
            candidate) →
    LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap heap →
      heap.size ≤ bound →
        fuel ≤ heap.size →
          ∀ selected ∈ (LeanExperiments.HeapSort.drainRecursive fuel heap #[]).toList,
            ∀
              omitted ∈
                List.drop fuel
                  (LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.extractMaxima LeanExperiments.HeapSort.popMaxRecursive
                    heap.size heap),
              omitted ≤ selected

      match extract₁ heap, extract₂ heap with

LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Sp.type:
∀ (bound fuel : ℕ) (heap output : Array ℕ),
  (∀ (candidate : Array ℕ),
      LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap candidate →
        candidate.size ≤ bound →
          LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.PopMaxRestCorrectFor LeanExperiments.HeapSort.popMaxRecursive
            candidate) →
    LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap heap →
      heap.size ≤ bound →
        heap.size ≤ fuel →
          List.Pairwise (fun earlier later => later ≤ earlier) output.toList →
            (∀ emitted ∈ output.toList, ∀ value ∈ heap.toList, value ≤ emitted) →
              LeanExperiments.Verification.Sorting.Spec.Correct (output.toList ++ heap.toList)

  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChild prefer heap exception →

      exception < heap.size →
        parent = (exception - 1) / 2 →
          prefer heap[exception]! heap[parent]! = true →
            (∀ (child parent : ℕ), prefer child parent = true → prefer parent child = false) →

      | LeanExperiments.QuickSort.QuickSortTask.sort (pivot :: rest) =>
        LeanExperiments.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackPotential
          (LeanExperiments.QuickSort.pushQuickSortTasks tasks.pop (List.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ pivot)) rest)

        LeanExperiments.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackPotential tasks.pop) <

  (∀ (candidate : Array ℕ),
      LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap candidate →
        candidate.size ≤ bound →
          LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.PopMaxRestCorrectFor LeanExperiments.HeapSort.popMaxRecursive
            candidate) →
    LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.MaxHeap heap →
      heap.size ≤ bound →
        fuel ≤ heap.size →
          List.Pairwise (fun earlier later => later ≤ earlier) output.toList →
            (∀ emitted ∈ output.toList, ∀ value ∈ heap.toList, value ≤ emitted) →
              ∀ (predicate : ℕ → Bool),
                LeanExperiments.Verification.Sorting.Spec.Ascending
                    (LeanExperiments.HeapSort.drainRecursive fuel heap output).toList ∧
                  (LeanExperiments.HeapSort.drainRecursive fuel heap output).size = output.size + fuel ∧
                    List.countP predicate (LeanExperiments.HeapSort.drainRecursive fuel heap output).toList +
                        List.countP predicate
                          (LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.extractRemainder
                              LeanExperiments.HeapSort.popMaxRecursive fuel heap).toList =
                      List.countP predicate output.toList + List.countP predicate heap.toList

  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChildWithSubtreeBound prefer heap exception →
    0 < exception →
      exception < heap.size →
        parent < heap.size →
          parent = (exception - 1) / 2 →
            prefer heap[exception]! heap[parent]! = true →
              (∀ (child parent : ℕ), prefer child parent = true → prefer parent child = false) →
                (∀ (first second third : ℕ),
                    prefer first second = true → prefer second third = true → prefer first third = true) →
                  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChild prefer
                    (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.swap heap exception parent) parent

  index < heap.size →
    parent < index →
      (2 * index + 1 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * index + 1]!) →
        (2 * index + 2 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * index + 2]!) →
          (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap

              true →
            have nextHeap :=

                  index).1;
            nextHeap[parent]! ≤ nextHeap[index]!

  (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap index).2.2 =
      true →
    have nextHeap :=
      (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap index).1;
    have nextIndex :=
      (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap index).2.1;
    index < nextIndex ∧
      nextIndex < heap.size ∧
        heap.size - nextIndex < heap.size - index ∧
          nextHeap[index]! ≤ nextHeap[nextIndex]! ∧ ∀ position < index, nextHeap[position]! = heap[position]!

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.siftDownStep_minPrefer_root_initializes_path
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ (heap : Array ℕ),
  (∀ (parent : ℕ),
      0 < parent →
        parent < heap.size →
          (2 * parent + 1 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * parent + 1]!) ∧
            (2 * parent + 2 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * parent + 2]!)) →
    (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap 0).2.2 =
        true →
      have best :=
        LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownBest LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap 0;
      have nextHeap :=
        (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap 0).1;
      LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.MinHeapExcept nextHeap best ∧
        nextHeap[0]! ≤ nextHeap[best]! ∧
          (2 * best + 1 < nextHeap.size → nextHeap[0]! ≤ nextHeap[2 * best + 1]!) ∧
            (2 * best + 2 < nextHeap.size → nextHeap[0]! ≤ nextHeap[2 * best + 2]!)

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ {prefer : ℕ → ℕ → Bool} {heap : Array ℕ} {exception parent sibling : ℕ},
  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChild prefer heap exception →
    exception < heap.size →
      parent < heap.size →
        parent = (exception - 1) / 2 →
          sibling = 2 * parent + 1 ∨ sibling = 2 * parent + 2 →
            sibling ≠ exception →
              sibling < heap.size →
                prefer heap[exception]! heap[parent]! = true →
                  (∀ (first second third : ℕ),
                      prefer first second = true → prefer second third = true → prefer first third = true) →
                    prefer (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.swap heap exception parent)[sibling]!
                        (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.swap heap exception parent)[parent]! =
                      false

  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrdered LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.maxPrefer lower →

      (∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < lower.size) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < upper.size), lower[i] ≤ upper[j]) →
        lower.size ≤ upper.size + 2 →
          upper.size ≤ lower.size + 1 →
            have lowerResult := LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.rebalanceLower lower upper;
            have result := LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.rebalanceUpper lowerResult.1 lowerResult.2;
            LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrdered LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.maxPrefer result.1 ∧
              LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrdered LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.minPrefer result.2 ∧

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.crossBoundary_after_routed_insert
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ {input : Array ℕ} (state : LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.State),
  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.StateInvariant input state →
    ∀ (value : ℕ),
      if state.lower.isEmpty = true then
        ∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ)
          (hLowerIndex :
            lowerIndex <
              (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                  value).size)
          (upperIndex : ℕ) (hUpperIndex : upperIndex < state.upper.size),
          (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                value)[lowerIndex] ≤
            state.upper[upperIndex]
      else
        if value ≤ state.lower[0]! then
          ∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ)
            (hLowerIndex :
              lowerIndex <
                (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer
                    state.lower value).size)
            (upperIndex : ℕ) (hUpperIndex : upperIndex < state.upper.size),
            (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                  value)[lowerIndex] ≤
              state.upper[upperIndex]
        else
          ∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ) (hLowerIndex : lowerIndex < state.lower.size) (upperIndex : ℕ)
            (hUpperIndex :
              upperIndex <
                (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer
                    state.upper value).size),
            state.lower[lowerIndex] ≤
              (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer state.upper
                  value)[upperIndex]

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.siftDownStep_minPrefer_recheck_contract
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:

  ∀ index < heap.size,
    have nextHeap :=
      (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap index).1;
    (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer nextHeap index).1 =
        nextHeap ∧
      (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer nextHeap
                index).2.1 =
          index ∧
        (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer nextHeap
                index).2.2 =
          false

      (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap index).2.1;

      heap.size ≤ bound →
        fuel ≤ heap.size →
          ∀ selected ∈ LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.extractMaxima extract fuel heap,

                List.drop fuel (LeanExperiments.Verification.HeapSort.Spec.extractMaxima extract heap.size heap),

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.insertRouted_partition_size
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ {input : Array ℕ} (state : LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.State) (value : ℕ),
  (state.lower.toList ++ state.upper.toList).Perm input.toList →
    if state.lower.isEmpty = true then
      ((LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                  value).toList ++
              state.upper.toList).Perm
          (input.push value).toList ∧
        (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
              value).size =
          state.lower.size + 1
    else
      if value ≤ state.lower[0]! then
        ((LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                    value).toList ++
                state.upper.toList).Perm
            (input.push value).toList ∧
          (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                value).size =
            state.lower.size + 1
      else
        (state.lower.toList ++
                (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer
                    state.upper value).toList).Perm
            (input.push value).toList ∧
          (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer state.upper
                value).size =
            state.upper.size + 1

  (∀ (candidate : Array ℕ),

          List.Pairwise (fun earlier later => later ≤ earlier) output.toList →
            (∀ emitted ∈ output.toList, ∀ value ∈ heap.toList, value ≤ emitted) →
              LeanExperiments.Verification.Sorting.Spec.Ascending

  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChildWithSubtreeBound prefer heap exception →

      exception < heap.size →
        parent < heap.size →
          parent = (exception - 1) / 2 →

              (∀ (child parent : ℕ), prefer child parent = true → prefer parent child = false) →
                (∀ (first second third : ℕ),
                    prefer first second = true → prefer second third = true → prefer first third = true) →
                  (∀ (value : ℕ), prefer value value = false) →
                    (∀ (first second third : ℕ),
                        prefer first second = false → prefer second third = false → prefer first third = false) →
                      LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChildWithSubtreeBound prefer

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChild.parent_row_after_swap
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ {prefer : ℕ → ℕ → Bool} {heap : Array ℕ} {exception parent : ℕ},
  LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.HeapOrderedExceptChildWithSubtreeBound prefer heap exception →
    0 < exception →
      exception < heap.size →
        parent < heap.size →
          parent = (exception - 1) / 2 →
            prefer heap[exception]! heap[parent]! = true →
              (∀ (child parent : ℕ), prefer child parent = true → prefer parent child = false) →
                (∀ (first second third : ℕ),
                    prefer first second = true → prefer second third = true → prefer first third = true) →
                  have swapped := LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.swap heap exception parent;
                  (2 * parent + 1 < swapped.size → prefer swapped[2 * parent + 1]! swapped[parent]! = false) ∧
                    (2 * parent + 2 < swapped.size → prefer swapped[2 * parent + 2]! swapped[parent]! = false)

        state.lower →
      (∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ) (hLowerIndex : lowerIndex < state.lower.size) (upperIndex : ℕ)
          (hUpperIndex : upperIndex < state.upper.size), state.lower[lowerIndex] ≤ state.upper[upperIndex]) →
        (value ≤ state.lower[0]! →
            ∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ)
              (hLowerIndex :
                lowerIndex <
                  (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer
                      state.lower value).size)
              (upperIndex : ℕ) (hUpperIndex : upperIndex < state.upper.size),
              (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.maxPrefer state.lower
                    value)[lowerIndex] ≤
                state.upper[upperIndex]) ∧
          (state.lower[0]! < value →
            ∀ (lowerIndex : ℕ) (hLowerIndex : lowerIndex < state.lower.size) (upperIndex : ℕ)
              (hUpperIndex :
                upperIndex <
                  (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer
                      state.upper value).size),
              state.lower[lowerIndex] ≤
                (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.insertHeap LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer
                    state.upper value)[upperIndex])

LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.siftDownStep_minPrefer_moves_minHeap_exception
LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedi.type:
∀ (heap : Array ℕ) (index parent : ℕ),
  index < heap.size →
    index = 2 * parent + 1 ∨ index = 2 * parent + 2 →
      LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.MinHeapExcept heap index →
        (2 * index + 1 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * index + 1]!) →
          (2 * index + 2 < heap.size → heap[parent]! ≤ heap[2 * index + 2]!) →
            (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap
                      index).2.2 =
                true →
              have best :=
                LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownBest LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap
                  index;
              have nextHeap :=
                (LeanExperiments.RunningMedian.siftDownStep LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.minPrefer heap
                    index).1;
              LeanExperiments.Verification.RunningMedian.MinHeapExcept nextHeap best ∧
                nextHeap[index]! ≤ nextHeap[best]! ∧
                  (2 * best + 1 < nextHeap.size → nextHeap[index]! ≤ nextHeap[2 * best + 1]!) ∧
                    (2 * best + 2 < nextHeap.size → nextHeap[index]! ≤ nextHeap[2 * best + 2]!)

LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.q.name: LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackOutput_output_prefix_backStep
LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.q.type:
∀ (outputPrefix : List ℕ) (tasks : Array LeanExperiments.QuickSort.QuickSortTask),
  tasks.size ≠ 0 →
    outputPrefix ++ LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackOutput✝ tasks =
      match tasks.back! with
      | LeanExperiments.QuickSort.QuickSortTask.sort [] =>
        outputPrefix ++ LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackOutput✝ tasks.pop
      | LeanExperiments.QuickSort.QuickSortTask.sort (pivot :: rest) =>
        outputPrefix ++
          LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackOutput✝
            (LeanExperiments.QuickSort.pushQuickSortTasks tasks.pop (List.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ pivot)) rest)
              (List.filter (fun x => decide (pivot < x)) rest) pivot)
      | LeanExperiments.QuickSort.QuickSortTask.emit value =>
        outputPrefix ++ [value] ++ LeanExperiments.Verification.QuickSort.quickSortTaskStackOutput✝ tasks.pop
